summary: Payments - Error with reader. Sending payments blocked.
reported_issue: When sending a payment to a physical Stripe/ShopPay card reader (terminal), an error occurred and payments were blocked. A previously duplicated reader connection was reported; after disconnecting/reconnecting, test connection succeeds but sending a payment to the terminal errors out, with the error changing on retry.
expected_after_fix: Payments can be sent to a connected card reader without the connection/send error; no duplicate reader entries.
steps_i_followed: Reviewed the ShopPay payments / reader flow scope: the reported defect is triggered by sending a live payment to a physical Stripe Terminal card reader (WisePOS/BBPOS hardware) and observing the reader error.
actual_now: This defect requires a physical Stripe/ShopPay card reader (terminal hardware) paired to the account and an actual payment sent to that device. No such hardware reader is available in the automated harness, and the send-to-terminal error path cannot be exercised without it (Stripe Terminal SDK talks to real/simulated devices, not reachable via headless browser + API here).
notes: Hardware-dependent (Stripe Terminal card reader). Out of scope for the browser/API harness; requires a paired physical reader to reproduce the send/connection error.
